_about: Toolkit-wide settings for the Dataverse write path. cli_version: the Dataverse CLI version doctor expects (pinned 1.0.81 on 10/7/26: pin current, update as we see fit in the toolkit. On SBRM Windows machines each new version is a new file ThreatLocker must approve). warn_rows: there is NO cap on how much one approval may change (ruled 10/7/26); a change to more than this many rows, pairs or objects is flagged 'Large change' at plan and in the pop-up (DESIGN.md 10j). dev_dirs: folders where the engine itself is developed; the guard lets code there reference the engine's write side, which it refuses everywhere else. Ships EMPTY (no internal paths in the public repo). Since 1.10.0 a developer's folders live in ~/.sbrm-dataverse/config/dev_dirs.json on their own machine (guard-protected, survives toolkit updates); this list is still read for older setups.
